seeds.hypothesis: Reversible content-aware compression may reduce F2 model-facing tokens while preserving exact evidence and allowing retrieval of omitted originals.
seeds.counterhypothesis: Compression may hide later-critical evidence, disturb cache/trace reproducibility, add latency, or duplicate ContextCompiler/RCPD.

seeds.hypothesis: Query-aware evidence-preserving compression may outperform generic compression for bounded F2 ContextViews.
seeds.counterhypothesis: Current-query optimization may hide evidence needed by counterhypotheses or later GRID cells and upstream benchmarks may not transfer.

seeds.hypothesis: A thin derived procedural/temporal memory layer may improve UnifiedDB retrieval and MethodMemory while UnifiedDB remains the only source of truth.
seeds.counterhypothesis: A second mutable memory/index can create duplicate truth, stale state, self-reinforcing recall bias and contaminated evaluation.

seeds.hypothesis: Graphiti temporal validity windows, episodes/provenance and incremental graph structures may sharpen a derived F2 temporal world-model index.
seeds.counterhypothesis: Graph DB plus LLM ingestion complexity may be heavier, slower and less causally clean than a thin F2-native derived graph over UnifiedDB.

seeds.hypothesis: AgentSight may provide an independent system-level witness for spawned F2 agents, subprocesses, file/network effects, tokens and latency beyond self-reported application telemetry.
seeds.counterhypothesis: eBPF/TLS tracing may impose privilege, platform, privacy and overhead costs and may duplicate the F2 telemetry spine.

seeds.hypothesis: AgentCgroup mechanisms may improve reproducible resource experiments and later resource envelopes for F2 child agents.
seeds.counterhypothesis: Modern-kernel/privileged enforcement complexity may be premature before functional architecture freeze; characterization code may be more useful than controller adoption.

seeds.hypothesis: uniprof may standardize CPU hotspot profiling across heterogeneous F2 modules and test workloads.
seeds.counterhypothesis: F2-native telemetry plus direct profilers may be lighter; container/elevation overhead may reduce value.
seeds.correction: The repository profiles APPLICATION CPU behavior for humans and AI agents. It is not a Retina human-identity/profile system; that initial interpretation is rejected by source evidence.

seeds.hypothesis: agenttop OTLP parsing, live session views and tool_use_id reconciliation may improve lightweight child-session observability.
seeds.counterhypothesis: AgentSight or F2-native telemetry may subsume it and upstream agent telemetry schemas can be incomplete/version-fragile.

seeds.hypothesis: Its routed performance-testing knowledge may be a low-token MethodMemory/skill donor for F2 performance experiments.
seeds.counterhypothesis: A static skill corpus may add stale/generic guidance without measurable gain over RCPD and live research.
